verifications.claim: Tiger Woods was arrested for his first DUI on May 29, 2017, in Jupiter, Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Tiger Woods' first DUI charge ... in 2017'; R6: 'On May 29, 2017, Woods was arrested in Jupiter, Fla., on suspicion of driving under the influence'; R2: 'In May 2017, Woods was charged with a DUI in Jupiter, Florida'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm date, location, and R1/R4 explicitly call it first DUI.

verifications.claim: Police found Tiger Woods asleep in his running car stopped in a lane.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'asleep behind the wheel of his car with the engine running. It was parked in a traffic lane'; R6: 'Police found him asleep in his black Mercedes at 3 a.m, stopped in the right lane. The engine of Woods’ car was still running'; R3: 'asleep at the wheel in his running car'

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods had a 0.00 breathalyzer test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'His breathalyzer test was negative (0.00) on the scene'; R1: 'He did a Breathalyzer test, which came out negative'

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods stated it was an "unexpected reaction" to prescribed medications (Vicodin, Xanax, etc.).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'explained that the incident was due to an “unexpected reaction” to multiple prescription drugs ... including Vicodin, Dilaudid, Xanax, Ambien and THC'; R1: 'Woods said he had taken a mix of prescription painkillers and had a bad reaction'; R3: 'Woods said he had taken a bad mix of painkillers'
verifications.reasoning: Exact phrasing and medications in R6.

verifications.claim: The arrest occurred around 3 a.m. in Jupiter, Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'at 3 a.m, ... in Jupiter, Fla.'; R4: 'at 3 a.m. ... in Jupiter Island'

verifications.claim: Police found Tiger Woods asleep at the wheel of his black Mercedes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'asleep in his black Mercedes'; R2: 'his Mercedes stopped on the road'; R3: 'asleep at the wheel in his running car'

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods' black Mercedes had two flat tires.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'his running car, which had two flat tires'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated for 2017 incident; car confirmed as black Mercedes elsewhere.

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods' black Mercedes had damage to both bumpers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'damage on the front and rear bumpers'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated for 2017; car confirmed as black Mercedes elsewhere.

verifications.claim: A toxicology report revealed a mix of prescription medications (Vicodin, Dilaudid, Xanax, Ambien) and THC in Tiger Woods' system.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'A toxicology report showed he had five drugs in his system then: Vicodin, Dilaudid, Xanax, Ambien and THC'; R6: 'including Vicodin, Dilaudid, Xanax, Ambien and THC'
verifications.reasoning: Exact drugs listed in toxicology report.

verifications.claim: In October 2017, Tiger Woods pleaded guilty to reckless driving.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'He pleaded guilty to reckless driving in 2017'; R6: 'Woods ultimately pleaded guilty to reckless driving'; R5: 'in May 2017, he pled guilty to reckless driving'
verifications.reasoning: Plea to reckless driving in 2017 supported, but specific month of October omitted.

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods' plea to reckless driving allowed him to avoid jail time by entering a DUI diversion program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'agreed to complete a first-time DUI offender program to stay out of jail'; R3: 'agreed to enter a diversion program as part of the plea deal'; R6: 'completed a DUI diversion program'
verifications.reasoning: Directly links plea, program, and avoiding jail.

verifications.claim: As part of the plea, Tiger Woods received one year of probation.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'He received a year of probation'

verifications.claim: As part of the plea, Tiger Woods received a fine.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: As part of the plea, Tiger Woods received community service.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: The 2017 incident occurred just weeks after a spinal fusion surgery in April 2017.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'self-medicating for pain following his spinal fusion in April 2017'
verifications.reasoning: Date and surgery directly linked to incident.

verifications.claim: The 2017 arrest is often confused with a 2009 car accident in Windermere, Florida.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources distinguish incidents but do not state they are often confused.

verifications.claim: The 2009 car accident was a separate incident.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R5/R6: Describe 2009 fire hydrant crash separately from 2017 DUI.
verifications.reasoning: All sources clearly list as distinct events.

verifications.claim: For the 2009 car accident, Tiger Woods was cited only for careless driving, not a DUI.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Woods was cited for careless driving and fined $164'; R5: 'cited for careless driving'; R6: 'traffic citation for careless driving'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly no DUI, only careless driving citation.
